officialJapaneseCatalog.evidence: Confirms 26/27 EPIC identity, seven sizes, complete geometry table, N/W/T manufacturer stiffness readings, ¥115,000 pre-tax / ¥126,500 tax-inclusive Japanese MSRP, True Twin/Twin Flex, TripleRadius, Negative, Active Camber, Super Light Core with mesh fiberglass plate, 1.8 mm high-carbon stainless edges, and IS7500 sintered base.
